segments.ja420:1.1: Bhusamhi [bhusampi (ka.), bhusaṃ hi (sī. niyya)] kuddhoti avekkhiyāna, na tāva daṇḍaṃ paṇayeyya issaro;
segments.ja420:1.3: Aṭṭhānaso appatirūpamattano, parassa dukkhāni bhusaṃ udīraye.
segments.ja420:2.1: Yato ca jāneyya pasādamattano, atthaṃ niyuñjeyya parassa dukkaṭaṃ;
segments.ja420:2.3: Tadāyamatthoti sayaṃ avekkhiya, athassa daṇḍaṃ sadisaṃ nivesaye.
segments.ja420:3.1: Na cāpi jhāpeti paraṃ na attanaṃ, amucchito yo nayate nayānayaṃ;
segments.ja420:3.3: Yo daṇḍadhāro bhavatīdha issaro, sa vaṇṇagutto siriyā na dhaṃsati.
segments.ja420:4.1: Ye khattiyā se anisammakārino, paṇenti daṇḍaṃ sahasā pamucchitā;
segments.ja420:4.3: Avaṇṇasaṃyutā [yuttāva (ka.)] jahanti jīvitaṃ, ito vimuttāpi ca yanti duggatiṃ.
segments.ja420:5.1: Dhamme ca ye ariyappavedite ratā, anuttarā te vacasā manasā kammunā ca;
segments.ja420:5.3: Te santisoraccasamādhisaṇṭhitā, vajanti lokaṃ dubhayaṃ tathāvidhā.
segments.ja420:6.1: Rājāhamasmi narapamadānamissaro, sacepi kujjhāmi ṭhapemi attanaṃ;
segments.ja420:6.3: Nisedhayanto janataṃ tathāvidhaṃ, paṇemi daṇḍaṃ anukampa yoniso.
segments.ja420:7.1: Sirī ca lakkhī ca taveva khattiya, janādhipa mā vijahi kudācanaṃ;
segments.ja420:7.3: Akkodhano niccapasannacitto, anīgho tuvaṃ vassasatāni pālaya.
segments.ja420:8.1: Guṇehi etehi upeta khattiya, ṭhitamariyavattī [vatti (sī.), vutti (ka.)] suvaco akodhano;
segments.ja420:8.3: Sukhī anuppīḷa pasāsamediniṃ [anuppīḷaṃ sahasamedaniṃ (ka.)], ito vimuttopi ca yāhi suggatiṃ.
segments.ja420:9.1: Evaṃ sunītena [suvinītena (pī.)] subhāsitena, dhammena ñāyena upāyaso nayaṃ;
segments.ja420:9.3: Nibbāpaye saṅkhubhitaṃ mahājanaṃ, mahāva megho salilena medininti [medaninti (syā. ka.)].
